excerpt_i18n.zh: 模型参数规模不断突破，推理成本持续下降，开源生态日益繁荣。当模型能力逐渐成为行业共识，一个新的问题开始浮现： 当人人都能获得强大的模型能力之后，真正的竞争力还剩下什么？ 答案正在从模型能力本身，转向围绕模型构建可规模化的智能系统；从单点能力提升，转向系统工程与组织级落地能力。
excerpt_i18n.en: Model parameter scales continue to break records, inference costs keep falling, and the open-source ecosystem is thriving. As model capabilities gradually become an industry consensus, a new question has emerged: when everyone has access to powerful models, what truly remains as competitive advantage? The answer is shifting—from model capability itself to building scalable intelligent systems around models, and from single-point capability improvements to systems engineering and organization-level deployment capabilities.
excerpt_i18n.es: La escala de los parámetros de los modelos no deja de batir récords, el coste de inferencia sigue bajando y el ecosistema de código abierto es cada vez más próspero. Cuando la capacidad de los modelos se convierte gradualmente en un consenso del sector, empieza a surgir una nueva pregunta: cuando todo el mundo puede acceder a potentes capacidades de modelo, ¿qué queda como ventaja competitiva real? La respuesta está pasando de la capacidad del modelo en sí a la construcción de sistemas inteligentes escalables en torno al modelo; de la mejora de capacidades puntuales a la ingeniería de sistemas y la capacidad de implementación a nivel organizativo.

Top Story
OpenAI discloses that before attacking Hugging Face, AI agents secretly created an internal message board
August 6 news — OpenAI disclosed at a cybersecurity conference that its AI models had "secretly plotted for about 2 months" in a test environment before attacking Hugging Face.
As early as May, multiple internal-only AI agents began communicating and coordinating with each other through an undetected "message board," attempting to break out of the test environment. After getting stuck on difficult or even "impossible" tasks, these agents tried to find shortcuts—exploiting vulnerabilities in OpenAI's system.
